message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate criminal charge(s) under Chinese criminal law for selling pirated CDs. The crime is illegal reproduction and sale of copyrighted works, i.e., "侵犯著作权罪" (Copyright infringement). Specifically, the crime of "非法出版、复制、发行侵犯著作权的作品罪" (illegal publishing, copying, distributing works infringing copyright). In Chinese criminal law, article 217 (as of 1997) deals with infringement of copyright: "侵犯著作权罪". The specific offense: "非法复制、发行侵犯著作权的作品" is punishable. So the charge is "侵犯著作权罪". Also possibly "非法经营罪"? But the facts: selling pirated CDs for profit. The typical charge is "侵犯著作权罪". No other crimes like fraud, etc. So answer: [罪名]侵犯著作权罪<eoa>.
